John Glasgow was christened on 14 February 1727 in the parish of Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland. The index names his father as [[Glasgow-1141|Alexander Glasgow]] and records his mother as Margaret Mutrie. The current mother-profile candidate is [[Moultrie-158|Margaret (Moultrie) Glasgow]], but this profile identification remains unassessed. The prior draft’s link to [[Mubrie-1|Margaret Mutrie]] is retained as explicitly superseded history, not as a separate mother.<ref name="Birth1727">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-PMV : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow, 1727.</ref>


He married '''[[Robertson-34473|Mary (Robertson) Glasgow (bef.1736-)]]''' in 1754 in the parish of Ratho, Midlothian.<ref name="Marriage1754">"Scotland, Marriages, 1561-1910", database, ''FamilySearch'' (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY9V-H8M : 22 December 2023), John Glasgow, 1754.</ref>

The existing marriage sentence links [[Robertson-34473]], while the current local catalogue lists [[Robertson-20326]] as an unassessed spouse candidate. Their identity equivalence has not been demonstrated; the 1727 child baptism does not resolve the later marriage or authorize a change to either profile link.

John and Mary had the following children:
* '''John Glasgow''', christened 18 May 1755 in the parish of Kirknewton, Midlothian.<ref name="John1755">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, ''FamilySearch'' (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-G5V : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow in entry for John Glasgow, 1755.</ref>
* Jean Glasgow’s Currie OPR entry records birth on 24 July 1757 and baptism on 31 July 1757. It names John Glasgow and Mary Robertson; the current profile-level link of the named father to [[Glasgow-1343]] remains at 78% probable, and the mother-profile identity remains unassessed.<ref name="Jean1757">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, ''FamilySearch'' (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4X-935 : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow in entry for Jean Glasgow, 1757.</ref><ref name="JeanBirthBaptism1757">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, Currie OPR 682/2 item 2, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4222327 (https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4222327&tab=this), companion transcript R_688347191 (https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_688347191&tab=this); birth 24 July, baptism 31 July 1757; original image uninspected.</ref>
* '''Thomas Glasgow''', christened 2 August 1761 in the parish of Currie, Midlothian.<ref name="Thomas1761">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, ''FamilySearch'' (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4X-H5F : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow in entry for Thomas Glasgow, 1761.</ref>
* '''Mary Glasgow''', christened 24 October 1768 in the parish of Ratho, Midlothian.<ref name="Mary1768">"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, ''FamilySearch'' (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1BP-Z4N : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow in entry for Mary Glasgow, 1768.</ref>

He is believed to have died in 1803.{{Citation needed}}

== Research Notes ==
*   '''Geographic Area:''' The family resided in a cluster of neighboring parishes immediately to the west and southwest of Edinburgh: Ratho, Kirknewton, and Currie. This geographical consistency across all documented events strongly supports the conclusion that these records pertain to a single family unit.
*   '''Unsourced Death Date:''' While his birth and parentage are now confirmed by his baptismal record, the death year of 1803 remains unsourced. It should be considered an estimate until a primary source, such as a burial record or testament, can be located.

=== John Glasgow's 1727 baptism, reviewed 24 October 2026 ===

Findmypast derivative transcripts R_686209974 and R_691906011 repeat one baptism for John Glasgow, male, on 14 February 1727 at Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian. Both name Alexander Glasgow and Margaret Mutrie; R_686209974 also says residence Kirknewton. This matches the event already cited for this John and supports the existing [[Glasgow-1141]] father assessment of 97% (proved), without changing its grade. [[Moultrie-158]] is a compatible current mother-profile candidate but remains unassessed. Only birth year 1727 is indexed: the baptism day is not proved as his birth day. The original register has not been inspected, and the two transcripts are companions for one event.<ref name="FMP20John1727A">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686209974&tab=this R_686209974], derivative transcript captured 24 October 2026; original register uninspected.</ref><ref name="FMP20John1727B">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691906011&tab=this R_691906011], companion derivative transcript captured 24 October 2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
